limitations: Source typos and questionable technical statements/calculations are preserved, not corrected.
All 51 original ROS figure bytes and archival image-register/placement CSV files remain unchanged. The newer remote commit’s removal of the public PDF and 16 full-slide supplements is preserved.
Source image labels remain in supplied figures; figures were not redrawn or OCR-reconstructed.
